statement.zh: 在整体之内形成的一个动作耦合部分与其余：它是部分的恰当它是部分的策略，是其余的亦然，两者都是只在它处处相同时；每个运行都是一个整体中部分的进程，其余形成其动作；一段进程只在某个配置复现而动作不同之处固定动作是谁的。
statement.en: One move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest: it is the part's exactly where it is the part's policy, the rest's likewise, both only if constant; every run is a part's course whose moves a rest forms; a course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied.

laws.zh: 部分与其余由在整体之内形成的一个动作耦合（同步积，动作从联合配置读出）：两方每一步取同一个动作，部分所做的就是其余所受的；耦合的整体就是积的 closedBy，动作读出而不读入；确定的律的耦合是确定的。
laws.en: A part and the rest are coupled by one move formed within the whole (the synchronized product, the move read off the joint configuration): both take one move at every step, what the part does being what the rest undergoes; the coupled whole is the product's closedBy, the move read off rather than read in; a coupling of determined laws is determined.

laws.zh: 动作经配置的一个读法形成，当它随读法所归并者同行（Learning.Lumped）：在整体之内形成的动作经整体的配置形成，经一个读法形成者经每个至少同样区分的读法形成，经不区分任何东西的读法只形成处处相同的动作。
laws.en: A move is formed through a reading of the configuration where it goes alike across what the reading lumps (Learning.Lumped): a move formed within the whole is formed through the whole's configuration, one formed through a reading is formed through every reading telling apart at least as much, and through a reading telling nothing apart only a move that is the same everywhere is formed.

laws.zh: 动作是部分的恰当它是部分的策略，是其余的恰当它是其余的策略，两者都是恰当它处处相同，所以有所不同的动作至多由一方单独形成。
laws.en: The move is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part, the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest, and both exactly where it is the same everywhere, so a move that differs anywhere is formed by at most one of them alone.

laws.zh: 部分的律确定、动作是部分的时，部分承载自己的律，不论其余如何，部分的进程相同；律是函数时，每一方的进程都是以动作为输入的标准模型的轨迹，部分自己的动作在部分之内循环，又是其余的输入，整体按一个确定的律循环。
laws.en: Where the part's law is determined and the move is the part's, the part carries a law of its own and its course is the same whatever the rest; where the laws are functions, each side's course is the trajectory of the standard model with the move as input, the part's own move goes round within the part and is the rest's input, and the whole goes round by one determined law.

laws.zh: 每个带标签过程的每个运行，无论动作如何，都是一个只有一个行动的整体中部分的进程，其余是一只钟，由它形成动作；进程的标准模型中，不读任何东西的律的动作只经阶段形成。
laws.en: Every run of a labelled process, whatever its moves, is the part's course in a whole of one action whose rest, a clock, forms the moves; in a course's standard model, the act of a law that reads nothing is formed through the stage alone.

laws.zh: 律是函数时，由列表所持的整体、其余或部分形成的动作从某步起周期地重复，起点与周期之和不超过列表的长度；反之每个套索都由其位置组成的其余形成；所以从不进入循环的动作需要不被任何列表所持的形成者。
laws.en: Where the laws are functions, moves formed by a whole, a rest or a part held by a list repeat from some step with some period, start and period within the list's length; conversely every lasso is formed by a rest of its positions; so moves that never settle into a cycle need a former that no list holds.

laws.zh: 沿一段进程，动作经配置形成，恰当某个在每个配置至多给一个动作的关系给出它们，不需判定；无物复现时每种读法都合，保留其历史的部分把每个动作读作自己的；部分复现而动作不同之处，其余在那里不同。
laws.en: Along a course the moves are formed through the configurations exactly where some relation giving at most one move at each configuration gives them, with no decision; where nothing recurs every reading fits, a part keeping its history reading every move as its own; where the part recurs with the move varied, the rest differs there.

laws.zh: 在有限一段上、配置的相等可判定时，动作由配置的策略给出，恰当它们在同一配置处从不不同；动作的相等也可判定时，没有策略给出它们，恰当某个配置复现而动作不同。
laws.en: On a finite stretch with equality of configurations decided, the moves are given by a policy of the configuration exactly where they never differ at one configuration; with equality of moves decided too, no policy gives them exactly where a configuration recurs with the move varied.

laws.zh: 见证：同一段进程由部分的动作之律与其余的动作之律容许，两者只在进程不到之处不同；动作对其律不起作用的部分对其余封闭，而它的动作是其余的；部分不动而动作交替时，部分不形成动作；由两者是否不同形成的动作不由任一方单独形成。
laws.en: Witnesses: one course admitted by the part's law of the move and by the rest's, which differ only where it never goes; a part to whose law the move makes no difference, closed against the rest while its move is the rest's; a part standing still while the move alternates, which does not form it; a move formed by whether the two differ, formed by neither alone.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。各律所写者写在定理中：部分的律确定（Determined），律是函数（每一步的后继由一个函数给出），配置在一个列表之内；配置与动作的相等可判定只用于有限一段上的策略与排除。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: the part's law determined (Determined), the laws functions (each step's successor given by a function), the configurations within a list; decided equality of configurations and of moves only for the policy and the exclusion on a finite stretch.

does_not_show.zh: 哪种切分恰当，实际的动作是否是部分自己的：部分与其余是给定的（积的两个分量）。
does_not_show.en: Which cut of an actual unfolding into part and rest is apt, or that an actual move is the part's own: the part and the rest are given (the two factors of the product).

does_not_show.zh: Run.withClock 以运行的动作为其余的数据：它说明任何动作都能读作在整体之内形成，不说明实际的展开有这样的其余，也不说明是哪一个。
does_not_show.en: Run.withClock takes the run's moves as the rest's data: it shows that every move can be read as formed within a whole, not that an actual unfolding has such a rest, or which.

does_not_show.zh: 一段进程不固定动作是谁的：同一段进程由部分的动作之律与其余的动作之律容许。
does_not_show.en: One course does not fix whose move it is: one course is admitted by the part's law of the move and by the rest's.

does_not_show.zh: 对其余封闭不推出动作是自己的。
does_not_show.en: Being closed against the rest does not imply that the move is one's own.

does_not_show.zh: 律不确定时取哪个后继：耦合只形成动作，不形成后继。
does_not_show.en: Which successor a law that is not determined takes: the coupling forms the move, not the successor.

does_not_show.zh: 部分形成动作的多少（耦合的度量）；反事实之动作经部分自身的耦合读出（ExchangeLaw.Through 对部分之外的形成陈述）；连续时间。
does_not_show.en: How much of a move a part forms (a measure of coupling); the counterfactual's act read through the part's own couplings (ExchangeLaw.Through is stated for the formations outside the part); continuous time.

does_not_show.zh: “一个动作，两侧”超出定义：part_act_eq_rest_act 由 rfl 成立；内容在哪些律容许它（one_course_two_laws、closed_not_own）与路线何时定下是谁的动作。
does_not_show.en: That "one move, two sides" goes beyond the definition: part_act_eq_rest_act holds by rfl; the content is in which laws admit the move (one_course_two_laws, closed_not_own) and when a course fixes whose it is.

detail.zh: Parity：动作是部分与其余是否不同；沿进程它不经部分的配置形成，也不经其余的配置形成，只经联合配置形成：并非每个动作都是某一方的。
detail.en: Parity: the move is whether the part and the rest differ; along the course it is formed through neither the part's configurations nor the rest's, only through the joint configuration: not every move is one side's.

next_delta.zh: 部分在动作中的份额在本记录的运行上陈述；反事实之动作经部分自身的耦合读出；非确定之律的后继由什么形成；连续时间；独立审查。
next_delta.en: The part's share of a move stated on this record's runs; the counterfactual's act read through the part's own couplings; what forms the successor of a law that is not determined; continuous time; an independent review.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 对律与历史是同一展开的两种读法：“yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”；2026-10-14 对从关系开始的重建：“please, finish all”。本结果回答 process-and-frame-as-readings 与 counterfactual-is-the-course 的 next_delta：动作何时在展开之内形成（总可如此读，其余形成它），何时是部分自己的（恰当它经部分的配置形成；一段进程只在配置复现而动作不同之处固定这一点）。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：行与受是同一个动作的两面；输入是其余的配置，外来的标签是表示略去其形成的动作；动作是谁的是关于未走之进程的主张；读得越多，越多是自己的；封闭不是自己的；所做之事的新需要开放或增长。
correspondence.en: Ren, 12 October 2026, on law and history as one unfolding read two ways: “yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”; 14 October 2026, on the relation-first re-founding: “please, finish all”. This result answers the next_delta of process-and-frame-as-readings and counterfactual-is-the-course: when a move is formed within the unfolding (it can always be read so, its rest forming it) and when it is the part's own (exactly where it is formed through the part's configuration; one course fixes this only where a configuration recurs with the move varied). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): acting and undergoing are one move read from its two sides; an input is the rest's configuration, and a label from outside is a move whose forming the representation leaves out; whose move it is, is a claim about courses not taken; reading more, more is one's own; closed is not own; novelty in what is done needs openness or growth.

detail.en: With the rest counted every world is one run of the law of exchange (World.unity); with the rest that forms the moves counted, every run of a labelled process is a part's course in a whole.

detail.zh: 对交换律回答其下一步中的度量：耦合强度是耦合的度量，部分的份额至多是其强度乘部分的改变（ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares）；与本记录的运行相连尚未陈述。
detail.en: Answers the measure in its next step for laws of exchange: the coupling strengths measure coupling, and the part's share of a move is at most its strengths times the part's change (ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares); the link to this record's runs is not yet stated.

detail.en: The stock-level counterpart of the sixth reading (novelty in what is done needs openness or growth): novelty needs gain, which with the rest counted comes from the rest or across the boundary.
